notes: Version 2.57 records the O18/TopologicalInvariants correction in O18 2.2, TopologicalInvariants 1.1, white paper 3.21 and GS-Note 2.4. O18's Born-Infeld-type action of the gradient of chi is its adopted model, not supplied by BornInfeld. TopologicalInvariants keeps charge quantisation and pi_2 = 0 on a chosen domain of the Hopf base; the phase-gradient bound is a hypothesis, the domain is a choice, and the absence of magnetic monopoles is open.
